description: Disable translate and color jitter during the final (partial) training epoch so the training distribution matches test.
Change forward_step's torch.compile mode from max-autotune to max-autotune-no-cudagraphs to check whether run time changes.
Replace the final MaxPool2d(3) with a 0.5*(max+avg) 3x3 pooling mix.
Raise the fraction of least-confident test images that get flip/shift TTA from 25% to 40%.
Disable color jitter augmentation in the training aug dict.
Set BATCH_SIZE to 1024, MUON_LR to 0.18 and EPOCHS to 7.0.
Narrow block2 width from 256 to 192 to cut FLOPs in the heaviest block, leaving EPOCHS unchanged.

issues: No integrity problems: the jitter scale is overwritten with fill_ at the start of every epoch, so no state carries over between runs or from the untimed first call. No seeding, no file access, no use of test images.

No result-invalidating bug: the scale is a 0-d half tensor passed into the compiled jitter function, so changing its value should not cause recompiles. The last epoch is already clean, so the scale only affects earlier epochs.

The candidate (cost 0.0204) is worse than the incumbent (-0.0706) by 0.091. Recomputed z with sd 0.026*sqrt(2) is about -2.47, consistent with the harness's -2.494. Reject is justified, though each side has only one run.

description: Linearly fade brightness/contrast jitter strength over epochs via a 0-dim CUDA scale tensor, keeping the clean final epoch.
Average model parameters over the last 3 training steps with a running mean and copy the result into the model before returning from train().
Use only the original and flipped views (2 instead of 6) in TTA and apply it to the 50% least confident test images.
Widen block1 from 64 to 96 channels and reduce EPOCHS from 7.65 to 7.2 to compensate for time.
Replace SiLU with ReLU in ConvGroup to test the speed/accuracy trade-off.
Make the last two training epochs clean (no translate or color jitter) instead of only the last one.
Set TRANSLATE to 1 to reduce translation augmentation and the padded tensor size.
Train the first 40% of steps on 28x28 bilinearly downsampled inputs (24x24 would break the final 3x3 pool), then switch to full 32x32.

Train the first 35% of steps on bilinearly downsampled 26x26 inputs (24x24 would break the final 3x3 pool) before switching to full 32x32, with automatic dynamic shapes disabled so each shape gets its own static compile.
Pass the step count to the compiled Newton-Schulz function as a CUDA tensor so it stops recompiling for every new int value.
Make the Muon target magnitude decay steeper by changing it from 0.5012 to 0.0786 into 0.55 to 0.05.
Use the first 2000 training images instead of 960 for the whitening covariance estimate in init_whiten.
Replace nn.SiLU with nn.GELU in ConvGroup's activation.
